eps.ov: While recovering, the warrior now living as Nia Liston discovers an unexpected fascination with Magivision technology.

eps.t: A Job in the Royal Capital
eps.ov: A demanding actress doesn't think much of Nia, unaware of how terrifyingly capable she really is.
Nia is leaving but not before making good on a promise.
Nia's first day at Altoire Academy is marked by a new friend and a new rival.
Nia settles into her new life at the academy.

eps.t: The Academy Martial Arts Tournament Is On!
eps.ov: As the academy prepares for a martial arts tournament, Nia learns about a far more dangerous arena.
The Umbral Arena is everything Nia had hoped for. But there's one thing she didn't expect: she recognizes one of the fighters.
Nia intervenes after witnessing an injury.
